purpose: Test whether the already prospective, fixed ten-vector Task14 upstream program composes through the previously localized downstream MLP15+17 branch, using an exact four-corner mediator clamp without fitting or changing the program.

supersedes.reason: v1 was abandoned before implementation solely because its hand-authored created_utc was two minutes later than its claim timestamp; all scientific terms below are unchanged.

queries: cardinality AND (MLP15 OR MLP17 OR mediation)
prototype AND (MLP15 OR MLP17 OR mediation)
prior_art_search.result: No existing experiment combines the fixed direction-cardinality prototype program with MLP15+17 mediation. Existing evidence separately establishes the program and localizes MLP15+17 for a natural head-11.3 donor intervention.

intervention.rows: all 32 rows and all 16 E/A/U/W background subsets from the untouched third corpus
upstream_corners: base head plus frozen direction-cardinality vector
mediator_corners: MLP15+17 final-token outputs clamped to their base-head values

predictions.pred_a_immutable_inputs_and_complete_ins: All immutable SHA checks pass; exactly 512 row-subset cells and all four corners are present; closure, base replay, and prior program-effect replay errors are each <=5e-5.
predictions.pred_b_mlp15_17_materially_mediate_progr: The mediated-effect vector has cosine >=0.50 with the full program effect, norm/full-effect norm in [0.15,1.50], and sign agreement >=0.65.
predictions.pred_c_mediation_generalizes_across_regi: Each direction x template group has mediated/full norm ratio >=0.10 and cosine >=0.25; each cardinality has mediated/full norm ratio >=0.10.
predictions.pred_d_direct_residual_route: Opposing outcome: the clamped program effect matches the full effect with cosine >=0.95, relative L2 error <=0.15, and sign agreement >=0.90.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_program_and_price: No vector, scale, row, subset, mediator, or threshold is selected after effects; price is at most 16 physical forwards, 2560 example evaluations, zero backwards, and zero parameter updates.

terminal_rule: Invalid if pred_a or pred_e fails; mediation_screen if pred_b and pred_c pass; direct_route_screen if pred_d passes; otherwise inconclusive.
closed_claims: semantic identity of MLP15 or MLP17
